verdict.rationale: Offering downloadable forms and instructions without an account is a fair question for a state tax agency, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes showing Akamai 403 edge denials to a keyless agent at robots.txt and the webapp host, and nothing was fetched beyond them. These walls neither show that forms and instructions are freely downloadable nor show that a human needs an account, so there is no evidence the capability is delivered.
